knowledge.purpose: Compact label that highlights status, count, or category next to other content
useCases: Unread count on a tab or icon
Status column of a list bound to data — status + variantMap draws each value in its own variant
antiPatterns: Form input chip — a badge only labels; it takes no input
knowledge.implementation:
Further use cases:
- New / Beta marker beside a feature name

Label weight follows the theme voice: font-weight reads var(--pw-font-weight-heading, 600) — a fixed 500 made every theme’s controls look alike while headingWeight runs 400–800.

Selected vs unselected: variant primary is filled (brand fill, on-primary ink, 2px primary-ink edge — clears 3:1 against the ground and an unselected badge in every preset, light and derived dark); default is an empty chip with a control edge. A stepper marks its active step with primary and the rest with default.

Data-driven status: bind status (or text) to the record field and give variantMap {value: variant}; the badge picks its variant per row.

jsonSchema.description: primary is the SELECTED/active state: a filled brand chip with a 2px ink edge. default is the unselected state: empty, a control edge, muted ink. The status variants are soft tints with an edge.
The value variantMap is looked up by — bind the record field here ("{{item.status}}"). Unset: the badge text is the key.

Value → variant, so a status badge bound to data draws each status in its own variant: {"Sold out": "error", "Open": "success", "*": "default"}. Exact match first, then case/space-insensitive, then "*", then variant.
